item.title: [paper] Optimal Linear Regression Without a Variance
item.description: Algorithmic reduction method that converts standard finite-variance linear regression procedures into robust estimators for infinite-variance noise regimes.

item.title: [paper] A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning
item.description: Benchmark study evaluating linear regression, RNNs, and LSTMs for S&P 500 forecasting while correcting for common methodological sources of performance inflation.

item.title: [paper] MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
item.description: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures.

item.title: [paper] On the Complete Feature Set for ADHD Classification in Children and Adolescents Based on EEG Signals
item.description: Curated dataset of 669 EEG recordings from 156 participants across five task conditions enables researchers to consistently compare seven feature families for ADHD classification in children and adolescents.

item.title: [paper] Non-penetrating World Models
item.description: A benchmark and lightweight framework leverage hidden states from frozen diffusion transformers to detect and prevent object penetration in interactive video world models, reducing physical violations and generalizing zero-shot.

item.title: [paper] Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
item.description: Model Carving jointly optimizes a Transformer's weights and topology during training by applying learnable scalar gates to remove sublayers, producing more efficient and higher-performing models.

item.title: [paper] Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization
item.description: Ranking-preserving coreset selection framework accelerates evolutionary hyperparameter optimization by constructing a compact subset that maintains the relative ranking of candidate configurations.

item.title: [paper] Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
item.description: Topology Hub Optimal Transport is a sparse attention method that replaces dense matrices with linear-size graphs and specialized kernels to eliminate long-context dilution at high speeds.

item.title: [paper] The Optimal Sample Complexity of Agnostic PAC Learning for Partial Concept Classes
item.description: Deterministic agnostic PAC learner uses optimal sample complexity to return a total concept satisfying error bounds for partial concept classes of finite VC dimension.

item.title: [paper] DiTraR: Diverse Scorers and Transcript-Guided Re-ranking for Video Corpus Moment Retrieval
item.description: DiTraR is a video corpus moment retrieval framework that uses diverse scorers, multi-scorer energy ensembles, and a transcript verifier to improve video selection and moment re-ranking.

item.title: [paper] BioEmu2: Scalable Emulation of Biomolecular Dynamics
item.description: BioEmu2 is a generative biomolecular dynamics model that combines static structure prediction, equilibrium sampling, and time evolution to simulate multi-component systems significantly faster than molecular dynamics.

item.title: [paper] ESSI: Computationally Efficient Semantic Search for Sparse Autoencoder Concepts
item.description: Efficient Semantic Sparse Identification is a computationally efficient method that uses segmentation masks and binary search to identify and rank sparse autoencoder features for semantic model steering.

item.title: [paper] SUAF: Spectral Universal Advantage Features for Zero-Shot Policy Improvement
item.description: Spectral Universal Advantage Features are paired features derived from canonical dependence analysis that enable reward-free data reuse and zero-shot policy improvement in reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] Augmentation of cardiovascular flow measurements with generative diffusion models
item.description: Generative diffusion models reconstruct missing information in cardiovascular flow measurements by generating plausible probabilistic ensembles of velocity and gradient fluctuations from limited observations.

item.title: [paper] StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning
item.description: StereoVLM is a geometry-aware binocular vision-language model trained with hierarchical supervision from calibrated stereo to enable metric 3D spatial reasoning, evaluated by Stereo3D-Bench.

item.title: [paper] Star Panoptic Quality: Selectively Evaluating Split and Merged Instances
item.description: Star Panoptic Quality is a novel evaluation framework that isolates and weights failure modes in instance segmentation, enabling practitioners to account for instance delineation biases.

item.title: [paper] Functional Depth Is Learned: Isolating the Computation That Layers Produce Only Together
item.description: An exact inclusion-exclusion decomposition method tracks how transformers develop functional depth during pretraining, revealing that cross-layer dependencies strengthen and become behaviorally consequential over time.

item.title: [paper] Decision Columns as an Index: Interpretable Embeddings for Explainable Entity Matching and Search
item.description: Interpretable embeddings built from decision columns enable explainable entity matching and search by storing calibrated answers to natural-language questions, decomposing similarity into per-question contributions.

item.title: [paper] AnimalFarm: Auditing the Generation and Detection of Hateful Images Featuring Anthropomorphic Characters
item.description: A systematic study and benchmark of hateful image generation and detection involving anthropomorphic characters reveals severe safety gaps in current AI models and detectors.

item.title: [paper] QuantStream3D: Geometry-Aligned Low-Bit KV Cache Quantization for Streaming Visual Geometry Transformers
item.description: QuantStream3D is a geometry-aligned low-bit key-value cache quantization framework for streaming visual geometry transformers that protects sensitive cross-view evidence and improves reconstruction quality.

item.title: [paper] Communication-Efficient Federated Learning of Latent Patient Representations from Multi-Institutional EHRs
item.description: A communication-efficient federated spectral method learns shared latent patient representations from multi-institutional electronic health records while keeping patient-level data local and private.

item.title: [paper] The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework: Scalable Multimodal UX Attribution in Web Search
item.description: The Dual-Tier Sentiment Framework is an industrial architecture combining fine-tuned and multimodal large language models to automate user experience regression detection and visual diagnostic attribution.

item.title: [paper] TEA-Bench-BR: Can Coding Agents Turn a Branching Clinical Specification into Correct Code?
item.description: TEA-Bench-BR is a benchmark based on early autism screening pathways designed to test whether coding agents can accurately translate complex branching clinical specifications into correct code.

item.title: [paper] FairITR: Fairness-Aware Learning of Multicategory Individualized Treatment Rules
item.description: FairITR is a fairness-aware learning framework for multicategory individualized treatment rules that integrates adversarial learning and covariance-based regularization to optimize both treatment outcomes and decision fairness.

item.title: [paper] Speculative Decoding Is Less Speculative Than You Think
item.description: Draw-Informed Candidate Selection is a speculative decoding method that pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness to accelerate language-model inference without altering the target sampling distribution.

item.title: [paper] Renormalized Entropy from Symmetries: Simplicity Bias and Neural Heat Death
item.description: Researchers study the implicit bias of neural network parameter symmetries, finding that an entropy term derived at positive temperature can cause a preference for low-rank functions or neural heat death.

item.title: [paper] Interpretable Tissue Architecture Complements Pathology Foundation Models
item.description: A study introduces a 139-dimensional cellular-to-community tissue representation that, when fused with pathology foundation models, improves classification performance on breast cancer and lung histopathology datasets.

item.title: [paper] LesionAgent: Training-Free Agentic Tumor Tracking and Response Assessment in Longitudinal CT
item.description: LesionAgent is an LLM-powered agent that uses frozen 3D models to perform longitudinal CT tumor tracking and response assessment without task-specific training.

item.title: [paper] From Gist to Verbatim: The Controllable Path of One Image Through a Diffusion Prior
item.description: Researchers explore how generative models recall single images, showing that memory transitions from abstract semantic representation to exact verbatim reproduction during training.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Visual Fidelity: Comparing Categorical and Continuous World Models
item.description: A study compares categorical and continuous prediction in visual world models, demonstrating that categorical models achieve higher rollout validity and long-horizon performance with less training compute.

item.title: [paper] Integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence with Learning Style Models: Opportunities, Challenges, and Future Directions
item.description: A review examines how generative artificial intelligence integrates with established learning style models to support student engagement in large online classes.

item.title: [paper] SLICR: Strategy Logic-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description: SLICR is a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that uses Strategy Logic and linear temporal logic to handle adversarial settings under partial observability.

item.title: [paper] OpenAHBU: Open-sourced Automatic Human Behaviour Understanding Toolkit Through Facial Behaviour Analysis
item.description: OpenAHBU is an open-source toolkit integrating eleven facial behavior understanding functions across three semantic levels to analyze short-term attributes and psychological states and traits.

item.title: [paper] Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
item.description: SplitBench is a privilege separation framework for evaluating coding agents that isolates test execution from result judging to prevent agents from manipulating evaluation infrastructure.

item.title: [paper] ENC-QA: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Electronic Navigational Charts
item.description: ENC-QA is a diagnostic benchmark comprising over 77,000 questions derived from electronic navigational charts to evaluate vision-language models on nautical feature recognition and spatial reasoning.

item.title: [paper] Anchors That Move Without Collapsing: Exclusive-Region Anchor Routing for Vision Transformers
item.description: Exclusive-region anchor routing for vision transformers proposes hard exclusive patch assignments that improve accuracy and efficiency by preventing anchor collapse.

item.title: [paper] DGC-Net: A Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network for Projection-Supervised OCTA Segmentation
item.description: Depth-Geometric Conditioning Network (DGC-Net) recasts 3D-to-2D optical coherence tomography angiography segmentation using depth-moment conditioning and holistic depth-geometry modulation to achieve state-of-the-art mIoU performance.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Self-Critique: Epistemic Convergence Control for Multi-Agent Research Verification
item.description: A multi-agent research verification framework utilizes an asymmetric role architecture and belief-delta convergence criterion to cut LLM calls and reduce over-iteration while grounding claims in verified literature snippets.

item.title: [paper] Auditable Financial Knowledge Graphs: Schema-Driven Construction and Intrinsic Quality Evaluation
item.description: An auditable financial knowledge graph construction methodology uses schema-driven phased extraction and fine-grained provenance to parse temporal financial documents into traceable knowledge graphs.

item.title: [paper] DistDNA: Language Model Fingerprinting under Stochastic Decoding
item.description: DistDNA represents large language models by their prompt-conditional response distributions and compares them using maximum mean discrepancy to identify model checkpoints under stochastic decoding without a classifier.

item.title: [paper] Graph Signal Generation via Graph-Aware Diffusion Models
item.description: Graph-aware diffusion with mode-adaptive SNR scheduling improves graph signal imputation, forecasting, and recommendation accuracy by driving forward noise with heat diffusion on the graph.

item.title: [paper] Mixture of Latent Recursions for Low-Rank Adaptation
item.description: Mixture of Latent Recursions (MoLR) recursively refines down-projected latent representations using a shared transformation and a lightweight router to enhance low-rank adaptation expressiveness with minimal parameter overhead.

item.title: [paper] Underwater Spectral Recovery via Multi-View Hyperspectral Imaging
item.description: A physically grounded framework uses multi-view hyperspectral imaging and low-rank basis functions to lift underwater restoration to continuous spectral radiance by jointly constraining scene radiance and water parameters.

item.title: [paper] Sampling non-abelian lattice gauge theories with diffusion models
item.description: Gauge-equivariant diffusion models utilize lattice gauge-equivariant convolutional neural networks and the Metropolis-adjusted annealed Langevin algorithm to accurately sample two-dimensional U(2) and four-dimensional SU(3) lattice gauge theories.

item.title: [paper] Autonomous quantum machine learning via Riemannian gradient-based optimization
item.description: A framework for autonomous self-training quantum machine learning uses Riemannian gradient optimization entirely within the quantum domain to remove the classical optimization loop, provide exponential convergence guarantees, and automatically discover hidden symmetries.

item.title: [paper] Redesigning Neural Networks to Not be Confidently Wrong even to Strong Adversarial Attacks
item.description: Shallow neural network architecture that reduces false high-confidence predictions on unknown classes or noise, improving alignment with human visual perception and enabling accurate identification of adversarial samples.

item.title: [paper] SLP-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Acoustic Claims of Reasoning Audio Language Models on Clinical Speech
item.description: Speech Language Pathologist Bench is a benchmark that grades acoustic claims in audio language models' chains of thought against clinician ratings across five datasets and 25 perceptual dimensions.

item.title: [paper] DOiT: Better Money-Flow Ranking Can Coexist with Worse Account Selection in Anti-Money Laundering Review
item.description: DOiT separates account selection and money-flow ranking decisions in anti-money laundering review, protecting upstream order while retaining graph neural network analysis where supported by evidence.

item.title: [paper] $\mathtt{DistP}$: Scaling Local-Update Training with Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
item.description: DistP is a theoretical framework that extends zero-shot hyperparameter transfer to local-update training with varying worker counts, local steps, and outer optimizers, improving model quality and reducing validation loss.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Prompting Strategies for Zero-Shot Multilingual Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis with Large Language Models
item.description: Systematic evaluation of zero-shot multilingual target-aspect-sentiment detection across 12 languages and three domains using seven open-weight models under four prompting paradigms.

item.title: [paper] Refrain: Learning Multi-Shot Consistency from Inconsistent References for A$^2$O Video Generation
item.description: Refrain is a unified video generation model that learns cross-shot consistency through a self-supervised reconstruction task, mapping image and video references onto a shared temporal canvas without auxiliary conditioning modules.

item.title: [paper] ChildAI-Gov: An Evidence-Linked AI System for Assessing EdTech Policies Against Children's Digital Rights
item.description: ChildAI-Gov is an explainable AI system that assesses whether education-technology policies respect children's digital rights by combining large-language-model judgments with deterministic rule checks and retrieval-augmented generation.

item.title: [paper] $\varepsilon$-SegFormer: Multi-Resolution Vision Transformers for Sparsely Supervised Segmentation in Electron Microscopy
item.description: varepsilon-SegFormer is a multi-resolution Vision Transformer for sparsely supervised semantic segmentation in electron microscopy that samples views at three physical resolutions and encodes token positions in a shared frame.

item.title: [paper] Energy-preserving Bayesian model reduction: closed-form structured posteriors and probabilistic stability certificates for quadratic operator inference
item.description: Energy-preserving Bayesian model reduction framework that imposes energy preservation of quadratic operators as linear equality constraints within Bayesian operator inference to yield closed-form structured posteriors and probabilistic stability certificates.

item.title: [paper] Feasibility of Multifrequency Neural Network-Based Wave Inversion in Ultrasound Time-Harmonic Elastography
item.description: Study investigating the feasibility of adapting the MF-ElastoNet multifrequency neural network-based wave reconstruction method from magnetic resonance elastography to ultrasound time-harmonic elastography for soft-tissue stiffness mapping.

item.title: [paper] When Does Looking Closer Pay Off? Simple Foveated ViTs for Fine-Grained Recognition
item.description: Vision Transformer model that uses class attention from a low-resolution glance to select image regions for high-resolution refinement, saving transformer operations for fine-grained recognition tasks.

item.title: [paper] Neural Defend ARCAS 290M: A Robust Foundation Model for AI-Generated Audio Detection
item.description: Neural Defend ARCAS 290M is an AI-generated audio detection foundation model that generalizes across various text-to-speech, voice-conversion, and channel conditions for fraud prevention and media verification.

item.title: [paper] A Benchmark Protocol and Fairness Analysis Towards Open-Set EEG Seizure Type Classification
item.description: Benchmark protocol and open-set recognition methods for automated EEG seizure type classification that evaluate performance when encountering rare or atypical seizure types outside the training data.

item.title: [paper] Search-RSI: Expanding Search Worlds Along Multimodal Agents' Capability Frontier
item.description: Search-RSI is a recursive self-improvement framework that expands the search world along a multimodal agent's capability frontier to improve performance on knowledge-intensive visual question answering.

item.title: [paper] QuASAR: Toward an LLM-Assisted Framework for Screening, Prototyping, and Assessing Quantum-Advantage Opportunities in Scientific Computing
item.description: QuASAR is an LLM-driven pipeline that screens scientific literature for computational kernels with quantum-algorithmic analogues, builds prototypes, and benchmarks them against classical baselines.

item.title: [paper] Enhancing Attention with Higher-Order Attention
item.description: Higher-order attention methods use conditional mutual information and generalized maximum entropy principles to enhance the information content of autoregressive probabilities in decoder language models.

item.title: [paper] From Novel Combinations to Informative Absence: Structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice in language learning
item.description: Generative theory of language learning that decomposes utterance generation into structural permission, communicative opportunity, and form choice to model how learners infer grammatical expressions and negative evidence.

item.title: [paper] DPMA: Learning to Compress Mixture-of-Experts Models
item.description: DPMA is a differentiable compression method for Mixture-of-Experts models that jointly learns to prune, merge, and absorb experts through gradient descent under a global budget.

item.title: [paper] Ref-YOLO-World: Decoupling Text-Side Computation for Efficient Referring Expression Comprehension on Edge Devices
item.description: Ref-YOLO-World is an efficient referring expression comprehension model that decouples text-side computation and caches per-token text features to accelerate video frame processing on edge devices.

item.title: [paper] An Asymptotic One-Sample Surrogate for Non-Gaussian ERM with General Convex Regularization
item.description: Asymptotic one-sample surrogate for convex empirical risk minimization with non-Gaussian features and nonsmooth penalties that preserves penalties and calibrates coefficients using the feature-label joint law.

item.title: [paper] SUPERVISE: A Unified Framework for Standardized and Reproducible Superpixel Evaluation
item.description: SUPERVISE is a unified and reproducible evaluation benchmark that enables fair cross-method comparisons of image segmentation superpixels through a scale-normalized protocol.

item.title: [paper] Budgeted Subset Selection with a Transferable Learned Value Model
item.description: Subset Acquisition with Learned Value Estimates and Search is a framework that decomposes subset selection into value estimation and diversity-penalized search to transfer across tasks.

item.title: [paper] RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
item.description: RoSci-Bench and the RoSci-Agent framework evaluate and improve vision-language model robustness by vetting premises for errors and inconsistencies before performing scientific reasoning.

item.title: [paper] Shared Understanding in Human-AI Teams: Coordination Continuity in Evolving Work
item.description: Coordination continuity is a framework that helps collaborators sustain a workable basis for interdependent action during extended, asynchronous workflows with AI agents.

item.title: [paper] Pre-Crawl Prioritization and Seed Classification for Large-Scale Web Archiving
item.description: Pre-crawl prioritization techniques use URL lexical analysis, domain reputation, and predictive content models to improve web-archival crawl completeness while reducing redundant visits.

item.title: [paper] Can Vision-Language Models Synthesize Executable Game-Playing Programs?
item.description: PlayScriptBench is a script-based game benchmark and four-stage pipeline that evaluates whether vision-language models can synthesize executable game-playing programs from game states.

item.title: [paper] Average-Depth Variable Execution via Request-Local Token Routing
item.description: AVERT is a layer-skipping method for large language models that routes tokens to execute varying numbers of layers while matching a continuous per-request depth budget.
